_anchor_note: The game the player reports as comfortable. Every multiplier is relative to this one, and the working-vocabulary estimate is inferred from its coverage curve.
_population_note: all-dialogue = main story, side content, companion and ambient lines. NOT item descriptions or documents (that is all-text). Comparing corpora collected under different populations is invalid, so `measure` refuses to build one table out of two.
_wiki_note: Hosts are the conventional Fandom names and are UNVERIFIED — they could not be reached from the machine this was written on. Run `run.py discover <slug>` before trusting any row.
_shared_wiki_note: A wiki covering a whole series will hand back the wrong game's dialogue. Those entries carry shared_wiki: true and are REFUSED until game_filter is set from what `discover` reports.
_load_note: The `load` fields cannot be derived from a transcript and must be filled in by hand or left null. Nothing downstream invents them: a null stays null in the output.
